column1: # Golden question set for skills/sndocs. Tab-separated. `#` starts a comment; blank lines
# Every topic path named here was verified against the australia branch (and, for the
# family-divergent rows, the named branch) on 2026-08-08 — read it first, by heading, never
# whole, the same discipline SKILL.md itself follows.
# An author who also designed the retrieval strategy unconsciously writes questions that
# strategy already answers, so these were drafted against verified topics and are meant to be
# corrected by a maintainer who reviews them adversarially before they are trusted as a gate.
#   category       lookup | routing | synonym | api-slice | family | absent | empty | no-trigger
#   family_pin     family to pin via a temporary project .sndocs file, or "-" for the default
#   question       the prompt given to the agent verbatim
#   expect_topics  comma-separated substrings that must all appear somewhere in the agent's
#                  tool-call stream (file paths read, commands run) — "-" if the case expects no
#   expect_url     a substring the cited canonical_url must contain, beyond the base docs host
#                  — used to prove a pinned family's URL segment was actually cited, "-" if not
#   mode           found | absent | empty | no-retrieval — which assertion function run.sh applies
